value.name: leaf_atlas_deep
value.prompt: Texture atlas for a real-time game engine: a 2x2 grid of four separate leafy branch clusters of European linden and hornbeam trees in summer, seen from above, dense overlapping leaves, deep saturated green leaves with some olive and a few yellowish leaves, natural, each cluster fills most of its own quadrant without touching the others, soft daylight, isolated on a fully transparent background, photorealistic, no text
